description: NaP₁₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaP₁₅ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.46 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ sites. In the first P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.19 Å) and one longer (2.31 Å) P-P bond length. In the second P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. There are a spread of P-P bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.24 Å. In the third P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing PNaP₃ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.22 Å) P-P bond lengths. In the fourth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing PNaP₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-P bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.28 Å. In the fifth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.25 Å. In the sixth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing PNaP₃ tetrahedra. The P-P bond length is 2.22 Å. In the seventh P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing PNaP₃ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (2.18 Å) and one longer (2.19 Å) P-P bond length. In the eighth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) P-P bond lengths. In the ninth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.25 Å. In the tenth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. In the eleventh P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.18 Å. In the twelfth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms to form distorted PNa₂P₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four PNaP₃ tetrahedra, corners with four PNaP₃ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one PNa₂P₂ tetrahedra. In the thirteenth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.18 Å. In the fourteenth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms. In the fifteenth P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ site, P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three P⁰ᐧ⁰⁷⁻ atoms.
